titles.title: Stop Superbugs Act
Stop Superbugs Act

A bill to require the Director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases to award a competitive grant for the Antibiotic Resistance Leadership Group for the purpose of facilitating a clinical research network on antibiotic resistance, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
